tasks.goal: Patrol the Charter Hall perimeter path so Progress Tracker can verify charter display kiosks are unobstructed.
tasks.terrain: Asphalt and gravel service roads around the Pentagon's south parking; curb cuts, bollards, and jersey barriers near building entrances.
success: All 6 waypoints reached within 0.3 m tolerance
safety_stops: Geofence: halt 10 m from any building entrance
Wheel slip above threshold on gravel
tasks.human_in_loop: A steward approves the patrol route file before launch and reviews any kiosk-obstruction flags.

tasks.goal: Retrieve bound research volumes from library shelving and deliver them to the synthesis desk.
tasks.terrain: Smooth interior lab flooring; low shelving, cable runs, and desk chairs as obstacles.
success: Object placed within 5 cm of desk target
safety_stops: Human within 1.5 m of arm workspace
tasks.human_in_loop: Lab staff approve the pick list; a person confirms each volume is correct at the desk.

tasks.goal: Act as forum moderator assistant, signaling speaking order and reading proposal summaries aloud to assembled participants.
tasks.terrain: Flat forum floor with tiered seating edges, microphone stands, and seated audience members.
success: Correct speaker-order cues on 95% of turns
tasks.human_in_loop: A human moderator approves every summary script before Nao reads it; voting is never agent-run.

tasks.goal: Climb the observatory mezzanine stairs to inspect outcome-metric display panels and read gauge LEDs for the Progress Tracker.
tasks.terrain: Concrete stairs, metal railings, cable trays along mezzanine edge; outdoor-adjacent humidity near the Potomac affecting floor grip.
success: Panel gauge readback matches ground truth 98%
safety_stops: Foot slip detected on stair edge
tasks.human_in_loop: An operator arms Spot each session and reviews flagged panel readings before they enter progress records.

tasks.goal: Fly a small indoor swarm sweep to map task-routing whiteboard zones and verify working-group station markers.
tasks.terrain: Open high-ceiling deck; ceiling-mounted ducts, hanging signage, and desk partitions as aerial obstacles; HVAC drafts.
success: Coverage of 95% of deck grid at 0.5 m resolution
Position hold within ±10 cm at marker stations
No airframe contact events in 20 flights
safety_stops: Obstacle within 0.4 m on range deck
tasks.human_in_loop: Deck lead approves flight volume and ceiling limit; a person validates station-marker mismatches.

success: Bracket assembly cycle time under 90 s
Bolt seat torque within ±0.2 Nm of spec
